newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai finance firm ratings seen lower long term.
newsitem.headline: Thai finance firm ratings seen lower long term.

text.p: Credit ratings of most Thai finance companies are expected to be lower in the longer term due to intensifying competition in financial markets, a senior industry official said on Thursday.

"In the long run, the ratings of finance companies will be gradually lower due to the stiffer competition," Vuthiphong Priebjrivat, managing director at Thai Rating and Information Services, told reporters.
Vuthiphong said the entry of new local and foreign banks will increase competition in the market and significantly affect the finance companies' existing businesses.
The larger loan exposure of most finance companies to the property sector than commercial banks will also affect their credit ratings, he added.
